verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a GenAI DDQ feature with questionnaire autofill automation, so questionnaire handling exists in some form. Nothing in the evidence shows which formats it accepts or that it exports answers back in the customer's original format. Missing for 10: importing SIG, CAIQ, portal-based and spreadsheet questionnaires, exporting in the format the customer sent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
